reviews_h2: Straight from the people who called us

reviews.author: Timothy Jackson
reviews.text: Cash Plumbing is amazing ! Is always on time , the same day, very reasonable pricing, and an honest company! If you ever need plumbing needs around the Fayetteville area please don’t go any further than Cash plumbing because they will save you time and Cash!

reviews.author: Diane Rzepka
reviews.text: Where do I start. He was awesome. My exterior was leaking from under my siding. Randy came out the same day and determined it was the laundry line. Got everything replaced, and I was so relieved he didn't charge me an arm and a leg. What he charged me equates to most companies charging just to diagnose, and he did it all for less. He discussed anything else I wanted to know, like getting a tankless water heater and installing a shower for my dogs. He said he treats his clients like he's working on his own house, and it shows. Plus, he showed the same day.

reviews.author: Savonnie Washington
reviews.text: Randy was awesome! Came in and got the job done. So nice, kind and down to earth. Felt like i was talking to one of my cousins! Definitely saving his number in my phone if we ever need this kind of service again. Price was affordable!

reviews.author: Timothy Adamaszek
reviews.text: Mr. Randy and his crew were lifesaving! I had a bad back up in my washing machine drain that I tried to snake and clear. When I did that the snake was caught. The snake was a rental so there was a deadline on returning that. I called Randy and I knew he was the right person to call from the moment he answered the phone. He was down to earth and easy to talk to about my problem, which quite frankly was embarrassing to me b/c I usually am able to handle jobs around the house. Randy and his crew came the very next morning (because I called him after five). My kids of course were in virtual school which Mr. Randy and his crew did not disturb at all. My problem was much greater then I imagined and I could see the dollar bills running in my head. Mr. Randy continued to work at my problem no matter what road block he faced and made it a priority to solve it as if it was his problem to solve. I am glad to say that they did solve the problem clearing my drain, retrieving the rental tool and repairing my drain line. When I got the bill it was really reasonable given all the hard work they did. Mr. Randy and his crew have a customer for life! Thanks for all your help! Please call him if you need a plumber!

reviews.author: Jenn Díaz
reviews.text: This was my first time using a plumber in Hope Mills and I’m glad I chose Randy Cash to do the job! He got my garbage disposal up and running again and even brought my dishwasher back from the dead! I gave him a call and he showed up within an hour. He is a very knowledgeable man and will explain the issue and how to resolve it yourself in the future.

reviews.author: Donna Solt
reviews.text: What a great company He came out after 11:00 PM was pleasant kind and understanding.His fee was so very reasonable for coming out after hours I will use him again It was great doing business with him.. Thank you so much Randy you’re awesome!!! Donna S

reviews.author: Jean Smith
reviews.text: Cash plumbing is the best I called and that was it he came and did the work right away and at a great price me and the wife are very happy thank you and your great service.
